_doc: Bishop line skill definitions (spec #372, ticket BS2 #374). Each skill ticket appends its own region of `skills` (separate tickets, separate regions): BS4 Heal (2301002); BS5 (#377) Holy Arrow (2301005), Shining Ray (2311004), Angel Ray (2321007) and Teleport (2301001, moved from magician.json as teleport_cleric); BS6 Genesis (2321008) and Big Bang (2321001, via extends big_bang); BS7 Summon Dragon (2311006) and Bahamut (2321003); BS8 Resurrection (2321006, #380). A pool key with no entry here stays inert: it is never offered or learned. Tier C cooldowns are the F/P base values x0.4 (GAME_DESIGN 7.80).

holy_arrow._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.80.
holy_arrow.name: Holy Arrow
holy_arrow.desc: Cleric. Shoots a holy arrow at the nearest monster.

text.desc: Attacks the nearest monster by firing Holy Arrows. Very effective against undead and devil-based monsters.

holy_arrow._tuning: Tier C: same flight, reach, radius and recast as Fire Arrow, cooldown 0.4 s (1.0 s x0.4), default eight-rank table; canonical mad/mastery and the holy element are tier A.

shining_ray._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.80.
shining_ray.name: Shining Ray
shining_ray.desc: Strikes nearby monsters with a burst of holy light.

text.desc: Attacks surrounding monsters with a ray of holy light. Very effective against undead and devil-based monsters.

shining_ray._survivor: Tier C: auto-cast with at least one monster in the canonical box, 1.2 s cooldown (3 s x0.4), magic2 stance held 0.8 s. Tier A: lt/rb (half-width 150 to level 10, 160 at 11-20, 170 from 21), mobCount 6, mad/mastery and elemAttr h from Skill.wz, action magic2; effect and hit/0 only (no ball), Use sound only.

angel_ray._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives; repeat scale 0.8. See GAME_DESIGN 8 and 7.80.
angel_ray.name: Angel Ray
angel_ray.desc: Fires a heavy holy ray at the nearest monster.

text.desc: Attacks the nearest monster with a heavy ray of holy light. Very effective against undead and devil-based monsters.

angel_ray._tuning: Tier C: nearest auto-cast, the Fire Arrow flight (range 480, 520 px/s) with radius 14, cooldown 1.0 s (2.5 s x0.4), one shot, shoot1 stance held 0.8 s. Tier A: mad/mastery and elemAttr h from Skill.wz, its own single-frame ball/0, action shoot1.

teleport_cleric.name: Teleport
teleport_cleric.desc: Press X and a direction to blink to a platform. Hold X to repeat.

text.desc: Press the Teleport key with an arrow key to teleport a set distance to another platform in the same map. Hold the key to keep teleporting.

teleport_cleric._teleport: Tier C: 0.3 s survivor repeat delay; bot blinks from threats within 60 px. Canonical mpCon and range from Skill.wz (130 to level 10, then +2 a level to 150 at level 20).

resurrection._rarity: Tier C: first-pass bonuses named after the lineage's passives (spec #372 BS8): Rare Faster Prayer shortens the recharge, Epic Holy Vigor raises the revive HP share (revive_hp), Unique Holy Shield lengthens the guard (revive_guard) and Legendary is the Unique's id (one repeat counter) plus Holy Vigor; repeat scale 0.8. Normal Mastery is cooldown x0.95 (damage:none rule, #346). See GAME_DESIGN 7.81 and the Bishop BS8 constants.
resurrection.name: Resurrection
resurrection.desc: When a hit would kill you, you come back instead.

text.desc: When a hit would have killed you, you do not die: you come back with part of your HP, nothing can hurt you for a moment and the monsters around you are shoved away. It recharges before it works again.

resurrection._survivor: Tier A: the 10 levels, the lt/rb box (-400,-350)..(400,250) at every level, the resurrection action, the effect (21 frames) and affected (15 frames, a 1320 ms lead-in first) art and the Use sound. Tier C: the whole reaction (a lethal hit that is not unrevivable does not kill while the skill is ready), the ranks mapped to levels 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, and the recharge table in seconds, the WZ cooltime curve rescaled as cooltime / 3 - 480 (600 s at rank 1 down to 120 s at rank 8; the real-cache test asserts it); no cooldown_field. The stance is held for the body's 3 x 840 ms and is only drawn while standing: it never locks movement or casting.
resurrection._revive: Tier A: the box is the WZ lt/rb. Tier C: back at 50% max HP, a 2.0 s guard (every hit returns 0, boss attacks included), the monsters in the box shoved 140 px away (no damage, no status, bosses and steady monsters stay); GAME_DESIGN 7.81 and the Bishop BS3 and BS8 constants.
